topic: Sand reveals the still lines of a vibrating plate
centralQuestion: Why does sand on a vibrating plate form intricate patterns?
thesis: Sand migrates from moving regions toward still nodal lines, making plate vibration modes visible.
viewerPayoff: Recognize that sand highlights low-motion nodes rather than the most active regions or waves in air.
